intent.raw: Create a research strategy with dispatch-spec so we can understand AutoBayes, its related papers, the paper content, glossary, definitions, distilled knowledge, and translate it for the Arcanum developer without limiting the specification.
intent.objective: Plan a governed full-mode research tower for AutoBayes arXiv:2503.18608 that follows the domainspec-lean-formalization research-gpt example, produces glossary, definitions, distilled knowledge, related-paper mapping, Arcanum bridge decisions, and preserves promotion guardrails.
intent.operator_sentence: Use a research tower and full-mode dispatch fanout to understand AutoBayes in source language first, then translate it into Arcanum-shaped mental models for the operator.

route_menu.context_hint: The selected route mirrors ../domainspec-lean-formalization/research-gpt: a reflection tower with corpus, residue map, closure plan, gates, open residue, and next actions.

items.label: Tower-first full mode
items.description: Build the research tower, then authorize role-bound subagent research for source, related literature, glossary, distill, and Arcanum bridge lanes.

items.label: Paper summary first
items.description: Summarize the AutoBayes paper before governance artifacts; faster but weaker for durable Arcanum reuse.

items.label: Glossary first
items.description: Stabilize terms before broad related-paper research; useful if terminology drift is the main blocker.

technique_overlays.trigger: The user asked to follow the domainspec-lean-formalization example and go full mode.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Every research output must preserve source terms, name residues, and distinguish source-backed claims from Arcanum analogies.

technique_overlays.trigger: The route creates glossary, definitions, and distilled knowledge that could be mistaken for canonical Arcanum knowledge.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Research artifacts may propose candidate vocabulary, but canonical promotion requires owner review outside this dispatch.

steps.name: Recover paper, local precedent, and source context
stop_conditions: Block if the AutoBayes paper cannot be accessed.
Flag if the local Lean formalization example cannot be inspected.

steps.name: Build tower artifacts matching the Lean formalization example
convergence_criteria: The tower names levels, promotion rule, closure modes, and open residues.
The tower mirrors the Lean formalization example without copying its mathematics.
The tower speaks in Arcanum vocabulary while preserving source terms.
stop_conditions: Block if the route grants promotion authority.
Flag if the tower lacks closure gates.

steps.name: Run full-mode paper and related-literature research fanout
convergence_criteria: Each role returns source-backed findings, open residue, and confidence.
Each role distinguishes paper claims, related-paper claims, and Arcanum analogies.
No role promotes glossary, ontology, sigil, spell, or runtime authority.
stop_conditions: Block until the operator approves delegated full-mode subagents.
Block synthesis if a role lacks source evidence.
Flag if related papers are unavailable and classify the gap as missing-source residue.

steps.name: Produce glossary, definitions, and distilled knowledge
convergence_criteria: Each glossary term preserves the paper term before Arcanum translation.
Each definition states status: source-backed, seed, analogy, candidate, or rejected.
Each distill gives the operator a reusable Arcanum-shaped mental model.
stop_conditions: Block canonical promotion of glossary or definitions.
Flag analogy-heavy entries that lack source definition.

steps.name: Synthesize the AutoBayes to Arcanum bridge
convergence_criteria: Name borrow-now, analogy-only, reject, and promote-residue categories.
Preserve source term visibility in every bridge.
Identify which Arcanum owners would need to approve any future mutation.
stop_conditions: Block if the synthesis claims AutoBayes as an Arcanum spec.
Block if candidate bridge work skips owner review.

steps.name: Validate dispatch, gates, and open residue
convergence_criteria: Open residue has named next objects.
Next actions are executable and ordered.
stop_conditions: Flag if open residue lacks owner or next route.

steps.name: Prepare next-route handoff for full research execution
stop_conditions: Ask operator approval before executing subagent fanout.
Defer implementation changes until research closure.

subagent_strategy.trigger: The research problem spans one primary paper, multiple related theoretical and PPL papers, glossary stabilization, distillation, and Arcanum bridge synthesis.
subagent_strategy.explanation: Role-bound sibling agents reduce term drift by separating source reading, related-work comparison, operator-facing distillation, and promotion-guardrail stewardship.
context: The user asked to go full mode and to follow the domainspec-lean-formalization research tower example while making the language fit the Arcanum developer.

roles.purpose: Extract AutoBayes section structure, definitions, claims, and examples.
Close the Bayesian inversion chain-rule prerequisite.
Compare AutoBayes with generalized variational inference and Bayesian learning rule.
Clarify parameterized statistical games and optimization semantics.
Stabilize source terms and block canonical promotion drift.
Turn source-backed findings into Arcanum-shaped mental models.

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Run the AutoBayes full-mode research fanout with paper, related-literature, glossary, distill, and Arcanum-bridge roles, returning source-backed receipts only?
receipt_requirements: source claims with citation or artifact path

boundaries.contract: Full-mode research receipts may update local research glossary artifacts but cannot promote canonical Arcanum vocabulary.
Arcanum bridge outputs are candidate readings until an owning capability approves mutation.

state_namespaces.write_policy: Research artifacts may be written under research/autobayes only unless a later approved task expands scope.
No writes from this dispatch without explicit owner-review task.

promotion_splits.target: canonical Arcanum glossary, ontology, sigil, spell, or runtime contract
promotion_splits.rule: requires owner review and separate promotion route

gates.condition: Every research claim must distinguish AutoBayes source claims, related-paper claims, derived readings, Arcanum analogies, candidate bridges, and open questions.
The research artifact set must include README, TOWER, L0 corpus, L1 residue map, L2 closure plan, closure gates, open residue, glossary, definitions, distilled knowledge, and NEXT.
Recommended full-mode subagent execution requires explicit operator approval before delegated research runs.
Research outputs may propose candidate mappings but must not promote glossary, ontology, sigil, spell, memory, or runtime authority.
Distilled knowledge must be written for the Arcanum developer, preserving source language while translating into sigil, spell, dispatch, residue, handoff, and observability terms.
The dispatch must pass formulae/dispatch-spec/scripts/validate-dispatch.py before being treated as handoff-ready.

promotion_guardrails: Do not promote AutoBayes terms into canonical Arcanum vocabulary without owner review.
Do not treat the research tower as an implementation plan until a later approved task-session exists.
Do not collapse AutoBayes syntax, inversion, loss, parameter exposure, and optimization semantics into one Arcanum concept.
Do not treat related-paper summaries as source-closed until the related papers have been read.
Do not execute full-mode subagents without explicit operator approval.
